latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the jimeng skill using Jimeng AI 4.0 (Volcengine) for text-to-image and image-to-image generation.

- Supports generating images from text (t2i) or image references (i2i).
- Optional integration to send generated images directly to Feishu users.
- Includes default image reference for i2i mode.
- Simple command-line usage with customizable options and comprehensive examples.
- PNG image output; URLs provided for easy sharing and downloading.
